name: Knife
notes: Can de-sync players when their throat is cut (they appear dead to other players). Also, knife death may not sync for players killed in AFK

name: Katana
notes: Can not decapitate players (like in single-player)

name: Grenade
notes: Does not produce fire. Only synced for players that were streamed-in when a grenade was thrown

name: Teargas
notes: The coughing effect is disabled in SA-MP. Only synced for players that were streamed-in when a tear gas grenade was thrown

name: Molotov Cocktail
notes: Produces fire. Only synced for players that were streamed-in when a molotov cocktail was thrown

name: Colt 45
notes: Skill can be set with SetPlayerSkillLevel

notes: Skill can be set with SetPlayerSkillLevel

name: Rifle
notes: Skill can be set with SetPlayerSkillLevel, but it won't have any effect

name: Sniper Rifle
notes: Skill can be set with SetPlayerSkillLevel, but it won't have any effect

name: Rocket Launcher
notes: Only synced for players that were streamed-in when the projectile was launched

name: Heat Seeker
notes: Lock-on is not synced. Only synced for players that were streamed-in when the projectile was launched

name: Flamethrower
notes: This is used by a damage by fire, even when the fire is created by a rocket explosion or a molotov. Produced fire does not sync between players

name: Satchel Explosives
notes: Only synced for players that were streamed-in when the satchels were thrown

name: Bomb
notes: Given automatically when players throw a satchel charge (see ID 39) (omit from anti-cheat checks). It also detonates bombs thrown by other players

name: Spray Can
notes: Players that are sprayed choke

name: Fire Extinguisher
notes: Players that are sprayed choke

name: Camera
notes: Saves photos to player's gallery if enabled via pause menu (My Documents\GTA San Andreas User Files\Gallery)

name: Night Vision
notes: Visual effects show for all players (fix available)

name: Thermal Goggles
notes: Visual effects show for all players (fix available)

name: Parachute
notes: Players will die if teleported while diving with a parachute (can be fixed using ResetPlayerWeapons). Parachutes are given when bailing out of aircraft (omit from anti-cheat checks)

name: Fake Pistol
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc.

name: Vehicle
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc.

name: Helicopter Blades
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc.

name: Explosion
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc. This may sometimes be used at an indirect damage through an exploding rocket or grenade

name: Drowned
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc.

name: Splat
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc.

name: Connect
notes: Only usable in SendDeathMessage

name: Disconnect
notes: Only usable in SendDeathMessage

name: Suicide
notes: Only a death icon, can not be used in GivePlayerWeapon etc. Used when a player gets 0 HP by SetPlayerHealth, exploding in a vehicle etc.
